name: aspiration
quote: Someday I'd like to be a good bowler.
description: A desire to achieve a particular state of being someday without a specific plan to reach it.
perceptions: Life would be better if I could achieve a particular outcome.

comparisons.description: 'Aspiration' is more about a general state of desire while an 'ambition' is more about achieving a specific goal.
Inspiration is the immediate spark of a new idea or experience that can lead to an aspiration or ambition.

variations.name: longing
variations.description: A strong desire to achieve a particular outcome that creates a sense of loss and causes you to think about the desire frequently.
perceptions: Life would be better if I could achieve a particular outcome.
I think about this outcome so much that realizing it hasn't happened yet creates a sense of loss.
examples: A fixation on wanting to be rich and famous.

guidance.description: If you long for something that's obtainable, consider the guidance for ambition.
If you long for something that's not obtainable, consider the guidance for losing.

comparisons.description: An 'aspiration' is a garden-variety wish for a particular outcome. 'Longing' is a more like an addiction to dreaming about that state where the void becomes a discomfort.
'Longing' is revisiting an 'emptiness' over-and-over until it becomes painful.

commentaries.quote: To understand the heart and mind of a person, look not at what he has already achieved, but what he aspires to.

You cannot escape the results of your thoughts. Whatever your present environment may be, you will fall, remain or rise with your thoughts, your vision, your ideal. You will become as small as your controlling desire; as great as your dominant aspiration.
Consider the bloody history of Europe: there was a great aspiration for high culture, yet this very same culture was shaped by brutality and barbarism.
By aiming for paradise, we lose sight of earth. Hope of a beyond and aspiration to an afterlife engender a sense of futility in the present.
